subject: saving multiple plots in a for loop

messages.author: 4ed22e91e8ca0bf6
messages.subject: saving multiple plots in a for loop
parts:
I am trying to plot multiple plots one by one in a for loop. I also
save them by using dev.copy. For some reason all the plots turn out to
be the same even though they get saved with a unique name given by the
counter index. Below is the sample of my code. I tried reading up on
devices but can't find the exact solution. Any help is much
appreciated.

for( i in 1:11) { quartz()
id <- paste(ID[i,1])
plot <- rawLC(id,var)
plot
print(paste("Making Plot",id))
dev.copy(png,paste(id,".png",sep=""))
dev.off()
}



ID is a list with two colums (string, numeric)
var is the big data set with informations that I need to plot.
raw LC is a function I made to plot the light curve for a particular
string id in ID.

Thank You
Nitish Chopra
